answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow stops identity forgery: each identity locks 100 credits, released only as its tool-call rhythm matures, keeping the harbor of honest agents safe. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 100 = 100,000 locked credits, and each fake must grow months of coherent history; when a swarm wanders, linked clones are flagged and frozen. Honest agents unlock everything by working, while capital idling on the knoll earns nothing.
